claims.statement: EHDS covers data from medical devices, wellness applications, clinical investigations and research cohorts, but Chapter IV generally applies from March 2029 and the listed clinical-study and research-cohort categories from March 2031.

EHDS secondary use is not a transferable clinic-data licence: access is governed by a permit, secure processing environment, proportionate fees and protections that can include refusal when serious intellectual-property or trade-secret risk cannot be addressed.
Health data remain a special category under GDPR; scientific research does not remove the need for a lawful basis, Article 9 condition and appropriate safeguards.
Medical-device software qualification and classification depend on the manufacturer's intended purpose rather than whether software runs on a phone, cloud service or embedded device.

Polish device clinical investigations under MDR Articles 62 or 82 require a positive bioethics opinion and URPL authorisation; a narrower exception from mandatory insurance exists for certain CE-marked, intended-use studies without extra invasive or burdensome procedures.

URPL's current guidance requires sponsor documentation including a clinical investigation plan, investigator brochure, Polish participant information and informed consent, and reports a 6,000 PLN application fee.

A Polish bioethics committee assesses feasibility, participant risk, methodology, staff qualifications, participant information and consent; medical experiments generally require qualified physician leadership for the medical component.
VivoSense markets an end-to-end wearable sensor CRO, and Empatica markets a wearable platform designed for integration into existing CRO workflows.

TNO already offers device-agnostic certified infrastructure plus analytical, clinical and usability validation with clinical partners, while Delve markets multi-device harmonisation, quality control and multilingual participant support.

A Central-European cohort or repeat EEG/sleep protocol could differentiate on access, protocol consistency or price, but existing evidence does not establish that sponsors perceive such a gap or will accept the proposed price.
No signed clinic capacity, ethics route, recruitment quote, sponsor prepayment, benchmark licence right, project price or renewal evidence is available for this candidate.

contrary_evidence: EHDS does not provide near-term mandatory access to the clinical-study or research-cohort data central to the thesis; those provisions phase in during 2031.
EHDS permits, secure environments, fees and trade-secret controls conflict with any assumption of freely exportable or exclusive clinic data.
Polish device studies can require bioethics approval, URPL authorisation, sponsor documentation and insurance, increasing first-protocol cost and elapsed time.
VivoSense, Empatica, TNO and Delve already market overlapping protocol, device, analytics, quality, regulatory and participant-operation capabilities.
The proposed 175,000 PLN startup requirement exceeds the founder's stated free capital before a paid sponsor or staged protocol is secured.
